title: Nul model
text:
\[
h = \gamma_s \times \gamma_p \times \frac{\alpha_0 \times dbh}{\beta_0+dbh}
\]


Code
data <- readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1")
model <- cmdstan_model("models/nul.stan")
path <- "chains/nul_reduced"
if(file.exists(path))
  unlink(path, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(path)
fit <- model$sample(
    data = list(
      N = nrow(data),
      P = max(data$num_plot),
      S = max(data$num_species),
      plot = data$num_plot,
      species = data$num_species,
      h = data$H,
      dbh = data$dbh
    ),
    chains = 4,
    parallel_chains = 4,
    threads_per_chain = 4,
    save_warmup = FALSE,
    output_dir = path,
    refresh = 100
  )

title: Comparisons
text:
Code
data <- readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1")
fit_nul <- as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/nul_reduced", full.names = TRUE))
fit_s <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/system_reduced", full.names = TRUE))
fit_o <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/origin_reduced", full.names = TRUE))
fit_so <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/systemorigin_reduced", full.names = TRUE))
data$pred_nul <- fit_nul$summary("h_p", "median")$median
data$pred_s <- fit_s$summary("h_p", "median")$median
data$pred_o <- fit_o$summary("h_p", "median")$median
data$pred_so <- fit_so$summary("h_p", "median")$median
write_tsv(data, "outputs/data_pred_1.tsv")




Code
read_tsv("outputs/data_pred_1.tsv") %>% 
  select(system, H, pred_nul, 
         pred_s, pred_o, 
         pred_so) %>% 
  gather(model, prediction, -system, -H) %>% 
  mutate(model = recode(model, 
                        "pred_nul" = "nul",
                        "pred_o" = "origin",
                        "pred_s" = "system",
                        "pred_so" = "system-origin")) %>% 
  mutate(error = prediction - H) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(error, fill = model)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, col = NA) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~ system, scales = "free") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

title: Exploration
text:
Full model system-origin:
\[
h = \gamma_s \times \gamma_p \times \frac{\alpha_f \times dbh}{\beta_f+dbh} \\
\alpha_f \sim \mathcal N (\alpha_0,\sigma_f) \\
\beta_f \sim \mathcal N (\beta_0,\sigma_f)
\]


Code
data <- readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1")
fit <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/systemorigin_reduced", full.names = TRUE))
fit$summary(c("alpha_f", "beta_f"), 
            quantiles = ~ posterior::quantile2(., probs = c(0.05, 0.25, 
                                                            0.5, 0.75, 0.95))) %>% 
  separate(variable, c("parameter", "f", "systori"), convert = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-f) %>% 
  left_join(select(data, system, origin, systori) %>% unique()) %>% 
  select(-systori) %>% 
  gather(quantile, value, -parameter, -system, -origin) %>% 
  mutate(system = gsub("_", " ", system)) %>% 
  mutate(metric = paste0(parameter, "_", quantile)) %>% 
  select(-parameter, -quantile) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(beta_q50, alpha_q50,
             col = paste0(system, "\n", origin),
             label = paste0(system, "\n", origin))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = beta_q25, xend = beta_q75)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = beta_q5, xend = beta_q95), size = .2) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = alpha_q25, yend = alpha_q75)) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = alpha_q5, yend = alpha_q95), size = .2) +
  geom_point() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(box.padding = 0.4, ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_discrete(guide = "none") +
  ylab("Asymptotic height [ m ]") +
  xlab("Diameter at 50% height [ cm ]")
